parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located at the upper front of the table, typically rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or personal belongings. It slides in and out of the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: It can move linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden shelf located below the drawer, spanning between the side panels.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage or display space for items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the left side of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the right side of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden leg located at the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains its height and balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden leg located at the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains its height and balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden leg located at the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides rear structural support and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden leg located at the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides rear structural support and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Serves as the main working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
